correctness.rationale: Braun arXiv:0912.0720v1 Theorem 1.4 was read and verifies that for every k>=4 the reduced rational homology of Ind(SG_{2,k}) is concentrated in degree two. The explicit equivariant order-reversing face-poset maps p and q between the star subcomplex and complement-cycle chord graph satisfy pq=id and qp>=id; their compositions give an equivariant homotopy equivalence. All relative K/U faces are exactly the non-star triangle 2-cells. The equivariant Euler–Lefschetz trace identity therefore reduces H2 character to signed fixed vertices/chords/admissible triples, and every rotation and reflection type is counted with correct orientation signs. Exact independent scripts verify all 100 direct group actions for polygon sizes 8..12 and 364 cellular group actions for sizes 8..20, plus finite boundary-rank checks. These checks support rather than replace the complete infinite proof. No unproved integral or equivariant-homotopy conclusion is asserted.

value.rationale: The polygon-dihedral action is canonical for the rank-two stable Kneser family, and nonequivariant wedge multiplicity fails to distinguish it. A uniform all-m rational character with sharply different half-turn, order-three, and reflection classes is a natural exact equivariant invariant, enabling invariant-subspace and isotypical calculations for arbitrary polygon size. The explicit equivariant star reduction is structural rather than a one-off numerical table. The result is not a routine substitution in Braun or Schultz, whose known statements omit these actions or concern another complex.
